messages:
Kara (docs): opened PR #5981 to update the migration guide and add the JS streaming snippet. quick note: found a hard-coded KMS ARN in the example, will redact before merge.
Dev (platform): please paste the CI/docs preview link when ready so I can sanity-check the TOC anchors.
bot-preview: preview queued for PR #5981  https://ci.example.com/builds/5981
Kara (docs): problematic snippet: ```const c = new Client({ kmsKey: 'arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/aaaabbbb' });``` planning to replace with the canonical placeholder.
Alex (security): open a sensitive-docs ticket and mark as example-credentials; security won't sign off until redaction confirmed.
Kara (docs): RD-777 created and linked to the PR. replaced ARN with `arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT:key/KEY_ID` and added an advisory "avoid pasting live credentials into docs or CI logs". pushed update.
bot-preview: preview succeeded for PR #5981  https://ci.example.com/builds/5981/preview
Alex (security): reviewed RD-777 and the placeholder  security :thumbsup: passing to legal for tone.
Sam (legal): tiny wording tweak (prefer "avoid" over "do not"); otherwise OK, will post approval in PR comments.
Kara (docs): updated wording per legal. planning to merge in the docs merge window tomorrow at 09:00 PT. will add a changelog note and open a repo-wide sweep ticket for other literal ARNs. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
